# Whether each surface starts with a config file, pinned to the release
# before the config checks were rebuilt (7437238c), so start behaviour cannot
# drift unnoticed. Read by the terminal UI's start test (dux-tui) and by
# `dux server`'s (dux-web tests).
#
# One case per line: <terminal UI> <dux server> <the whole file, as a JSON
# string>. Each outcome is `start` or `refuse`. An outcome that differs from
# 7437238c on purpose is written `<now>(was:<then>)`, for a reason listed
# here:
#
# - A file that is not TOML (a broken header, a key written twice) stops
#   `dux server` too. 7437238c started it on the defaults, silently, which
#   would serve with no web password at all when the file meant to set one.
#
# The cases vary every setting 7437238c had (a valid other value and a value
# of the wrong type), the stock and a custom provider field by field, env,
# macro and key names, the deprecated keys, project records, tables of the
# user's own (near "auth" included) and whole-file oddities. [server.auth]
# did not exist then and is not in it.

start start "shutdown_timeout_seconds = 0\n"
refuse start "shutdown_timeout_seconds = -1\n"
start start "shutdown_timeout_seconds = 31\n"
refuse start "shutdown_timeout_seconds = \"many\"\n"
